content: Create React App is deprecated; standard 2025/2026 scaffolding for a React+TypeScript SPA is 'npm create vite@latest my-app -- --template react-ts', which gives fast dev server + optimized Rollup-based prod build. Since this project needs a pure client-rendered SPA (no SSR requirement), plain Vite is a better fit than Next.js, which is optimized around SSR/RSC and adds unneeded complexity for this use case.
